en-US.author: Readdle Limited
en-US.longDescription: Fast, cross-platform email designed to filter out the noise - so you can focus on what's important.
en-US.name: Spark Desktop
en-US.releaseNotes:
In this update:
- My Writing Style now lives in the new Personalization section in Settings, where you can set your preferred tone and length and manage the sample emails Spark learns from.
- Auto Drafts now includes an option to automatically delete drafts you don’t use.
- Autopilot rules can now run on a repeating schedule and be triggered by dates and times, and each rule now has a quick-actions menu in the rules list.
- Mail syncs faster and more reliably for IMAP accounts: new messages arrive quicker for Yahoo and AOL, and your inbox refreshes as soon as you return to Spark.
- Fixed an issue where Spark could show a “Not sent” notification for an email that was actually sent.
- Fixed an issue where restoring a Gmail message from the Bin could place it in the wrong folder.
- Fixed an issue where accounts that require multi-factor authentication could stop syncing without asking you to sign in again.
- Fixed several smaller issues affecting contacts, the folder picker, and Spark Assistant.
We’re always here for you at support@sparkmailapp.com

P.S. If you encounter any issues with the automatic update, please use the following link to download the update manually:
https://downloads.sparkmailapp.com/Spark3/win/dist/3.32.5.141587/Spark.exe
